notes: The page is the first-day Rosh Hashanah Torah reading, Genesis 21:9 (tail) through 21:23 (head).
The Tetragrammaton does not appear on this page. אֱלֹהִים is printed with a regular holam.
There are no qere/ketiv circlets or marginal qere notes. Every small circle on the page is a telisha gedola or telisha qetana accent.
The aliyah rubrics are ג. (בשבת ד.) after 21:12, (בשבת ה.) after 21:17, and פ ד. (בשבת ו.) after 21:21.

Accent and meteg placement where the print is ambiguous is listed in each block's uncertainties. In those spots the reading follows normal accent rules, so please check against a higher-resolution scan.
